19 to 26 inches, light brownish gray (2.5Y 6/2) heavy silt loam, grayish brown (2.5Y 5/2) moist; weak coarse prismatic structure parting to weak coarse blocks; hard, friable, sticky and slightly plastic; a few very fine roots; common, very fine pores; strongly efferyescent; common, fine threads and soft masses of lime; diffuse wayy boundary.
C2ca 26 to 37 inches, light brownish gray (2.5Y 6/2) silt loam, grayish brown (2.5Y 5/2) moist; weak, coarse prismatic structure; hard, friable, sticky and slightly plastic; common, very fine pores; strongly effervescent; common, fine soft masses of lime; diffuse wavy boundary.
37 to 65 inches, light olive gray (5Y 6/2) loam, olive (5Y 4/3) moist; massive, hard, friable, slightly sticky and slightly plastic; a few very fine pores; strongly effervescent; a few fine, soft masses of lime.
Thickness of the solum ranges from 9 to 18 inches. Depth to the carbonates ranges from 10 to 16 inches. Coarse fragments are modally absent but range up to 10 percent in some pedons. The Al horizon texture is silt loam or light silty clay loam. Thickness ranges from 2 to 4 inches. It has color range of grayish brown and brown. The B2t horizon has clay range of 25 to 35 percent. Thickness is 7 to 14 inches. The color range is brown and grayish brown. The Cca horizon has color range of light brownish gray, light gray and light yellowish brown. Segregated lime is in common fine and medium soft masses. Some profiles rest on gravelly sand and loam at depths below 3 feet.
Richfield soils are associated with Beauvais, Wages and Harvey soils. They have a thicker solum and less clayey B2t horizons than the Beauvais soils. They contain less sand than the Wages soils, and they are less limy than the Harvey soils.
Richfield silty clay loam, undulating (4 to 8 percent slopes) (Rld)
This soil is on grave benches and mantled shale land along river valleys. Drainageways are 8 to 25 feet deep. The soil profile is similar to the typical one described for the series.
The surface runoff is medium, and the erosion hazard is moderate.
This soil is suited to dryland crops and range. It is also suited to limited irrigated crops.
(Capability Unit IIIe-3 Dryland; IIIe-1 Irrigated; Silty range site 10-14 inch precipitation zone; Windbreak Suitability Group 1).
